subject: how to print() from Stan model on dev branch?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: how to print() from Stan model on dev branch?
parts:
The print() statements in Stan don't seem to produce
any output on the development branch. Are they turned
off by default somehow? I didn't see how to turn them on.

I tried a diagnostics file, but that didn't get the output.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] how to print() from Stan model on dev branch?
parts:
I looked closer and see that it is printing from the model, but
only on (before?) the first iteration.

Is that how we want print() to behave?

It doesn't really make sense to keep printing without having some
way to indicate what the iteration number is.


Here's the model:

|
|
transformed data {
real udummy;
{
real v;
real vv[10];
vector[12] vvv;
matrix[10,10] vvvv;
matrix[3,4] vvvvv[5];
print("transformed data: ",v," ",vv[1]," ",vvv[2]," ",vvvv[3,4]," ",vvvvv[1,2,3]);
}
}
parameters {
real y;
}
transformed parameters {
real wdummy;
{
real w;
real ww[10];
vector[12] www;
matrix[10,10] wwww;
matrix[3,4] wwwww[5];
print("transformed parameters: ",w," ",ww[1]," ",www[2]," ",wwww[3,4]," ",wwwww[1,2,3]);
}
}
model {
real z;
real zz[10];
vector[12] zzz;
matrix[10,10] zzzz;
matrix[10,10] zzzzz[10];
print("model: ",z," ",zz[1]," ",zzz[2]," ",zzzz[3,4]," ",zzzzz[3,4,5]);
y ~ normal(0,1);
}
|
|


And here's the output:

|
|
transformed data: nannannannannan
transformed parameters: nan:0nan:0nan:0nan:0nan:0
model: nan:0nan:0nan:0nan:0nan:0
STAN SAMPLING COMMAND
data = (specified model requires no data)
init = random initialization
init tries = 1
samples = samples.csv
append_samples = 0
save_warmup = 0
seed = 2247639986 (randomly generated)
chain_id = 1 (default)
iter = 2000
warmup = 1000
thin = 1
equal_step_sizes = 0
nondiag_mass = 0
leapfrog_steps = -1
max_treedepth = 10
epsilon = -1
epsilon_pm = 0
delta = 0.5
gamma = 0.05
Iteration: 1 / 2000 [ 0%] (Warmup)
Iteration: 10 / 2000 [ 0%] (Warmup)
Iteration: 20 / 2000 [ 1%] (Warmup)
Iteration: 30 / 2000 [ 1%] (Warmup)
|
|

Although not shown here, I've also fixed the issue with spaces.
I can make that a separate pull request of one line, or I could
roll it into this pull request.

- Bob

print() should definitely work at every call unless otherwise turned off.  Providing a way to get the iteration number (and maybe other step metadata) might be useful, but I'm not sure it's strictly necessary because we already print it out anyway.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] how to print() from Stan model on dev branch?
parts:
It's tricky --- you'd need to pass it in from
the outside, but then if we do something like an
ensemble sampler, it's going to be a pair of
replication and ensemble member. Maybe a string
that gets passed into the log_prob function to identify
the call somehow?

Anyway, this isn't urgent.

- Bob
